description: A local GLB's size, meshes, materials and animation clips, read from the file without rendering it. `viewer` gives the scale and bounds where the viewer places the model (centered on x and z, resting on y = 0), the space hotspots and cameras use; pass sceneId to apply that scene's normalization, which is otherwise off.

path.description: A GLB file on this machine; relative paths start at the project.

sceneId.description: A scene made from this file, whose normalization the viewer applies.

name: describe_model
title: Describe a model
